purpose: Cross-skill routing eval for the cfgver-* skill family. Each query has ONE expected winner among the cfgver skills, the generic pitfall skills (rocq-/bv-/gmap-pitfalls, iris-proofmode), the rocq plugin skills, or none. A skill firing on a query expected elsewhere = mis-route.
notes: v4 (2026-07-17): six rocq-command wrapper skills added (rocq-golf/review/refactor/doctor/checkpoint/formalize); Q14 expected changed rocq:golf -> rocq-golf; Q33-39 added (wrapper triggers + formalize-vs-new-example adversarial Q38 + autoprove guard Q39). v3 notes: Architecture v3 (2026-07-16 evening): contracts factored into cfgver-contracts (general/record) + cfgver-gen-contract (generator user guide) + cfgver-gen-contract-internals; recipe extracted to cfgver-new-example; solve_vc to cfgver-solve-vc; Q4/Q10/Q20 now expect cfgver-gen-contract. Q6 note: iris-proofmode also plausible (double-iFrame symptom) — endtoend should win on context. Q16 easy sanity check. Q19 probes the _tbl body gap. 18 cfgver-family skills + 4 generic pitfall skills under test. NOT yet re-run since v3. v5 (2026-07-18): added rocq-compile-oom (new skill for silent-kill/OOM diagnosis during heavy compiles) + Q40-44 (2 should-trigger, 2 adversarial near-misses against rocq-doctor/rocq-pitfalls, 1 guard against premature firing on routine async-tool waits). v6 (2026-07-18, later): cfgver-gen-contract description expanded to cover the parametric-base recipe (gen_contract_param/_rel) and the 'discharge valid_contract FIRST' bullet-ordering gotcha, discovered live when migrating all CFGVer examples to parametric base — added Q45 (adversarial: sounds exactly like rocq-compile-oom's territory but the real fix is cfgver-gen-contract's).
